map.由应付账款与营业成本求付款天数 使用指南: Payment Days from Accounts Payable and Cost of Sales User Guide
map.应付账款周转天数(DPO)计算器，输入应付账款余额与年营业成本，按 DPO=应付: The accounts payable days (DPO) calculator takes the accounts payable balance and annual cost of sales and computes DPO = accounts payable / cost of sales × 365 for the payment cycle, improving cash flow planning.
map.DPO = 应付账款/营业成本 × 365: DPO = accounts payable / cost of sales × 365
map.输入应付账款与年营业成本，求 DPO。: Enter accounts payable and annual cost of sales to get DPO.
map.衡量企业占用供应商资金的平均天数，反映议价能力与付款政策。: Reflects the average number of days a company ties up suppliers' money, showing bargaining power and payment policy.
map.对比 DSO 与 DIH，评估整体现金周期是否被供应商账期对冲。: Compare DSO with DIH to see whether the overall cash cycle is offset by supplier payment terms.
map.监控付款周期异常拉长，预警供应链关系或现金流压力。: Monitor an abnormally long payment cycle to warn of supply relationship or cash flow pressure.
map.：某公司期末应付账款 200 万元，年度营业成本 2400 万元，DPO=200: : with closing accounts payable of 2 million CNY and annual cost of sales of 24 million CNY, DPO=200÷(2400/365)=200÷6.575≈30.4 days, i.e. paying suppliers about every 30 days.
map.由应收账款与营收求收款天数: Collection days from accounts receivable and revenue
map.由经营现金流与债务偿付额求保障倍数: Debt service coverage ratio from operating cash flow and debt service
map.DPO 越长越好吗？: Is a longer DPO always better?
map.适当长可占用无息资金、改善现金周期，但过长会损害供应商关系、可能影响供货与折扣，: A moderately long DPO occupies interest-free funds and improves the cash cycle, but too long harms supplier relationships and may affect supply and discounts — balance negotiating power against credit.
map.DPO 与现金周期的关系？: What is the relationship between DPO and the cash cycle?
map.现金周期=DSO+DIH−DPO，DPO 是其中唯一减项，延长付款天数能缩短企业: Cash cycle = DSO + DIH − DPO; DPO is the only negative term, so extending payment days shortens the time the company's own cash is tied up.
